headline: Wonder Explores Sale of Grubhub to Retail Buyers
summary: Wonder is considering selling meal delivery platform Grubhub, with several major retailers emerging as potential buyers.
why: Grubhub is an online food ordering and delivery service operating across North America.

impacts.name: Grubhub
impacts.why: Grubhub is under evaluation for a corporate divestment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
